name: Retirement Visa (5-year)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires being at least 55, with at least 15 years' work history (inside or outside the UAE).

value.note: plus AED 1,000,000 in property, both required together

requirements.blocker_text: This requires owning property/properties worth at least AED 1,000,000 AND financial savings of at least AED 1,000,000.
requirements.fix_path: Build sufficient property and savings holdings.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires being at least 55, with at least 15 years' work history.
This requires an annual income of at least AED 180,000, from inside or outside the UAE.

evidence_required.document: Property valuation, savings statement, or income evidence matching the applicable group

outcome.duration_length: 5 years, renewable if criteria are maintained

sources.title: Residence visa for the retired - The Official Portal of the UAE Government

notes: work_rights marked 'restricted' rather than 'none' since holders may hold investments, rental income, and shareholdings, but may not take up salaried employment — a genuine middle position worth distinguishing from a pure no-work retiree route. Dubai's own 'Retire in Dubai' programme (GDRFA) offers a slightly different variant with some figure conflicts across sources (one reported Dubai-specific threshold cites AED 2,000,000 property + AED 20,000/month income rather than the federal AED 1,000,000+AED 1,000,000 or AED 180,000/year figures) — flagged as an emirate-level variance requiring direct confirmation before treating any single figure as universal, consistent with how this dataset generally handles cross-emirate variation. Same structural ceiling as every UAE route in this dataset: no PR, no citizenship path.
